videos.title: 100 Places to See
videos.description: Charente-Maritime is a 500-kilometre coastline that conceals an unsuspected heritage. From La Rochelle and its fortified port to the Île de Ré and its salt marshes, to Talmont-sur-Gironde, a medieval village perched on the estuary, this region reveals itself through the tides and encounters. An immersion between maritime traditions and historical relics.

videos.title: 100 Places to See
videos.description: The Pays d'Auge is the beating heart of Normandy. Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.
